

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(psych)

 d <- read_csv(here("misc_data/runbyrun.csv"))
 
 d %>% 
   group_by(param_id) %>% 
   nest()
```




```{r}
nested_d <- d %>% group_by(
  param_id, batch_id
) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  mutate(data = map(data, . %>% 
                      group_by(trial_id) %>% 
                      mutate(individual_run_id  = row_number()) %>%
                      ungroup() %>% 
                      select(-index, -stim_id) %>%
                      ungroup() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = individual_run_id, values_from = sample_n))) 
```

```{r}
all_icc_info <- lapply(seq(1, nrow(nested_d)), 
       function(id){
         print(id)
         data = nested_d$data[[id]]
         # many runs have missing trial_id
         if(nrow(data) >  1){
           return((ICC(data[, 2:ncol(data)])$results) %>% mutate(id = id))
         }
         
       }) %>% 
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
nested_id <- nested_d %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(id = row_number())
```

```{r}
all_icc_info %>% 
  filter(type == "ICC2k") %>% 
  left_join(nested_id %>% select(batch_id, param_id, id), by = c("id")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = ICC)) + 
  facet_wrap(~param_id) +
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}


 d %>% filter(param_id == 144) %>% 
  group_by(batch_id, param_id, trial_id) %>% 
  mutate(unique_id = paste(batch_id, param_id, trial_id, row_number(), sep = "_")) %>% 
  select(unique_id, sample_n, batch_id, trial_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial_id, values_from = sample_n, id_cols = c("batch_id", "unique_id"))
```
